correctness.rationale: From arXiv:0901.0671 Eqs. (25)-(26), the local configuration probabilities are products and the reduced state is diagonal, so its purity factorizes exactly. Applying the elementary product defect bound and per-walker probability normalization yields the stated IPR refinement and \(2M/L\) ceiling for arbitrary \(M\). The bundled exact-rational checker reproduces the factorization and inequalities on 19,607 local cases plus normalized multi-site examples; these computations supplement rather than replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The paper's open-chain phase diagram and open-versus-closed contrast are central to its physical conclusion. The accepted theorem converts that numerical/heuristic late-time decay into a universal finite-time structural ceiling, valid for every one-particle profile in the source's independent-walker model, and the IPR refinement identifies localization as an explicit suppressor. This is more than a routine finite computation or normalization check.
